threat_event: Business email compromise: an attacker takes over a commercial client's email or treasury credentials and sends altered payment instructions or pays new beneficiaries
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commercial clients use email for payment instructions; about 41,000 treasury clients; out-of-band beneficiary confirmation only at $100,000 or more
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 treasury platform; SYS-03 payments hub; BP-01; BP-09
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.a); N52-R02 (Supp. A); 12 CFR 21.11
existing_controls: Callback standard for emailed or phoned instructions; treasury MFA; fraud scoring; maker-checker; client education
treatment_plan: Out-of-band confirmation for every new beneficiary (POAM-007); beneficiary-plus-wire alert under $100,000 (POAM-006); client service BEC training (POAM-015)
key_risk_indicator: BEC attempts and losses per month; recall rate; share of new beneficiaries confirmed out of band

threat_event: Destructive attack (ransomware or wiper) encrypts or destroys data center systems, including the core and its replica in DC-2
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No logically isolated immutable copy of core data; 41 mainframe IDs with standing privileges outside PAM
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-03; DC-1 and DC-2; all core-dependent processes (P05)
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.h); 12 CFR 53.3; N52-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05)
existing_controls: 24x7 Cyber Defense Center; EDR; PAM for distributed and cloud; immutable cloud backups; annual core failover test
treatment_plan: Cyber vault for core data (POAM-020); mainframe privileged access into PAM (POAM-002); annual destructive-attack exercise with the disclosure committee
key_risk_indicator: Share of tier-1 data with isolated immutable copies; mainframe IDs outside PAM; mean time to contain

threat_event: Consumer account takeover through credential stuffing, phishing kits, or SIM swap, followed by transfers to mule accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23% of consumer users still receive SMS passcodes; 2.4 million digital users
existing_controls: Risk-based authentication; device binding; bot controls; fraud scoring
treatment_plan: Move SMS users to app push or security keys; step-up on trusted devices for new payees (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: Account takeover cases per 100,000 users; SMS share of authenticators

threat_event: Fraudulent wires through the acquired bank's legacy commercial online banking platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SMS passcodes only; no out-of-band confirmation of new beneficiaries; only login events in the SIEM; about 2,900 clients
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.a); N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.f)
existing_controls: Daily vendor report of beneficiary changes reviewed by treasury support; callback for large wires
treatment_plan: Accelerate migration to SYS-04 by 2027-02-26; interim callback for every new beneficiary (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Clients remaining on the legacy platform; new beneficiaries without callback

threat_event: A bank employee mailbox in commercial client services is compromised (token theft or adversary-in-the-middle phishing) and used to send or alter client payment instructions, with inbox rules hiding replies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client service staff exchange payment details with clients by email; no role-based BEC training for this group
existing_controls: Workforce MFA with number matching; external sender tags; auto-forward blocking; callback standard
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA and token protection for client service staff; inbox rule alerting; role-based training (POAM-015)
key_risk_indicator: Suspicious inbox rules detected; phishing-resistant MFA coverage for client service staff

threat_event: Second-line challenge of cyber risk is weak because the cyber risk oversight team reports through the CISO to the CIO, a front line unit executive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: App. D I.E.7(d) says no front line unit executive should oversee an independent risk management unit
existing_controls: CRO's Technology and Operational Risk team reviews cyber reporting quarterly
treatment_plan: Move the cyber risk oversight team to the CRO's Technology and Operational Risk group; board risk committee approves the change (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: Reporting line change completed; second-line challenges logged per quarter

threat_event: Privileged mainframe misuse, by an insider or with a stolen administrator credential, alters core data or audit settings without detection
threat_source: Malicious insider or external attacker with privileged credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 mainframe IDs with standing privileges outside PAM; 6 can alter core audit settings
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.a); N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.e)
existing_controls: Background checks; mainframe security product logging; quarterly spreadsheet certification
treatment_plan: Bring mainframe privileged IDs into PAM with session recording; remove audit-setting rights from administrators (POAM-002)
owner: Director of Data Center and Mainframe Operations
key_risk_indicator: Mainframe IDs outside PAM; audit setting changes

threat_event: Exfiltration of customer NPI from the enterprise data platform or digital banking data stores
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large copies of customer data in the data platform; egress monitoring tuned for known patterns
affected_asset_or_process: Enterprise data platform (Cloud B); digital data stores (Cloud A)
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B II.B.1); N52-R02 (Supp. A III); state breach laws; N52-R08
existing_controls: Data loss prevention; masking of account numbers; query logging; egress alerting
treatment_plan: Egress anomaly models for data platform exports; minimize raw customer data in analytics zones
key_risk_indicator: Large exports investigated; raw customer data sets in analytics zones

threat_event: A critical third party with customer information suffers a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 460 third parties with customer information; SOC reviews late for 7 critical third parties
affected_asset_or_process: Third parties (statement vendor, card processor, loan origination, trust platform)
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B III.D.2)-(3); N52-R02 (Supp. A II.A.2); 12 CFR 53.4
existing_controls: Tiered due diligence; contract security terms; SOC reviews; continuous external monitoring for tier-1 vendors
treatment_plan: Clear SOC review backlog and CUEC mapping (POAM-012); incident notice terms (POAM-019)
key_risk_indicator: Critical vendors with current SOC review; contracts with notice terms

threat_event: Card processor outage stops all debit and credit authorizations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single processor for debit and credit; stand-in covers only core outages
existing_controls: Processor DR tests observed; 53.4 contact confirmed
treatment_plan: Negotiate processor-side stand-in and a tested failover region; evaluate secondary processor for debit at 2027 renewal
owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking
key_risk_indicator: Processor availability; minutes of authorization outage

threat_event: AI-001 produces unexplained disparities for protected groups in the credit card segment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fair lending testing complete for personal loans but not the credit card segment
regulatory_driver: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4(a); 1002.6(b)(1)); SR 26-2
existing_controls: Model Risk Management validation; personal loan fair lending testing; second review of declines
treatment_plan: Complete fair lending testing for cards before full rollout (POAM-022)
key_risk_indicator: Approval-rate ratios by group; unexplained flags

threat_event: AI-001 adverse action notices give reasons that are too general for Regulation B
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 40 reason codes are general (for example "insufficient credit profile")
regulatory_driver: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.9(b)(2)); FCRA (15 U.S.C. 1681m(a))
existing_controls: Reason code mapping reviewed by Compliance for 37 of 40 codes
treatment_plan: Rewrite 3 reason codes; re-send corrected statements where needed (POAM-022)

threat_event: Generative AI use cases operate without an approved governance standard (SR 26-2 excludes generative AI from its scope)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Draft standard only; 4 of 16 use cases not reviewed
existing_controls: Approved-tool list; blocking of unapproved AI domains; AI governance committee reviews
treatment_plan: Approve the generative AI standard; review the 4 open use cases (POAM-023)
key_risk_indicator: Use cases reviewed; generative AI incidents

threat_event: A series of related incidents (such as BEC across several clients) is not assessed together for materiality, so an 8-K is filed late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality playbook assesses incidents one at a time; Item 106 defines a cybersecurity incident to include a series of related unauthorized occurrences
treatment_plan: Add aggregation of related occurrences to the playbook; exercise it with the BEC scenario (POAM-017)

threat_event: A notification incident is not determined and recorded promptly, so the OCC or Federal Reserve 36-hour notice is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 25 sampled incidents had no recorded determination time (P07 IR-4)
affected_asset_or_process: Incident management; OCC and Federal Reserve contacts
existing_controls: Determination criteria in the incident plan; contacts in the binder
treatment_plan: Make the determination field mandatory in case management for severity 1 and 2 (POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: Severity 1 and 2 cases with a recorded determination time

threat_event: A branch-originated wire request received by email or phone is processed without a callback
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 60 sampled branch-originated requests lacked callback evidence
existing_controls: Central callback team for treasury requests; written standard
treatment_plan: Route all branch-originated email and phone requests to the central callback team; required callback field (POAM-007)

threat_event: Attackers split fraudulent treasury wires under $100,000 to new beneficiaries to avoid out-of-band confirmation and monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Out-of-band confirmation only at $100,000 or more; no alert for beneficiary add plus wire under $100,000 within 24 hours
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.f); N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.a)
existing_controls: Fraud scoring of treasury payments; client-set dual approval
treatment_plan: New alert rule (POAM-006); out-of-band confirmation of every new beneficiary (POAM-007)

threat_event: Distributed denial-of-service attack degrades digital banking
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public-facing digital banking
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; WAF; second region
treatment_plan: Annual DDoS test with the provider; runbook for 53.3 determination during extended outages

threat_event: Zero-day in an internet-facing edge device (remote access gateway, firewall, or WAF) is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge devices from several vendors; emergency patch process
existing_controls: Threat intelligence; emergency patch target 72 h; EDR on servers behind the edge
treatment_plan: Reduce internet-facing device types; monitor edge devices with network detection

threat_event: Insider collusion in the wire room bypasses maker-checker to send fraudulent wires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Maker-checker enforced; callback team separate
existing_controls: Maker-checker; background checks; rotation; daily exception reports
treatment_plan: Add analytics on repeat maker-checker pairs

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a trusted vendor software update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Core, payments, and SaaS vendors push updates
existing_controls: Hash verification; staged rollout for tier-1 software
treatment_plan: Request software bills of materials from tier-1 vendors

threat_event: Treasury platform vendor outage exceeds the 2-hour BIA RTO for all commercial clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract RTO 4 h; fallback tested only at 200 instructions
existing_controls: Vendor secondary site; phone and file fallback with callback
treatment_plan: Renegotiate RTO at 2027-06 renewal; full-day fallback test; surge staffing for the callback team (POAM-018)

threat_event: Control failures at critical third parties go undetected because SOC reviews are late and CUECs are not mapped
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 41 critical SOC reviews late; CUECs mapped for 29 of 41
affected_asset_or_process: Card processor; other critical third parties
treatment_plan: Clear backlog; CUEC mapping for all 41 (POAM-012)

threat_event: The bank learns late of an incident at a critical third party because contracts lack notice terms and 53.4 contacts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 41 critical contracts lack notice terms and a designated 53.4 contact (5 from the acquired bank)
treatment_plan: Send designated contacts now; side letters; renewal terms (POAM-019)

threat_event: Terminated employees keep mainframe core access because removal is manual
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 60 sampled terminations removed 4 to 9 business days late, all on the mainframe
existing_controls: Identity governance for other systems; quarterly certification
treatment_plan: Mainframe connector for identity governance; interim daily reconciliation (POAM-001)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: Staff-assisted account takeover: contact data changed in the core by a staff member or social engineering goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Core maintenance events not in the SIEM
existing_controls: Contact center authentication; customer alerts on contact changes
treatment_plan: Forward core maintenance events; red-flag use cases (POAM-003)
key_risk_indicator: Contact changes followed by payee adds

threat_event: A dormant integration service account with a non-expiring password is used to query the customer information file
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Service account from a retired digital-to-core integration still enabled (found in P07 testing)
affected_asset_or_process: API layer; SYS-01 customer information file
existing_controls: Network restriction to the API layer subnet
treatment_plan: Disable the account; review all non-expiring service credentials; add service identities to quarterly certification (POAM-013)

threat_event: Sanctions screening engine fails at peak volume and wires cannot be released
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual capacity about 400 wires an hour against a peak of 2,500
treatment_plan: Surge staffing plan with the financial crimes team; risk-based release rules approved by the BSA/AML Officer (POAM-010)

threat_event: Core failover to DC-2 exceeds the 4-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tested 3 h 40 min in 2026
treatment_plan: Accept: tested within RTO; retest annually
owner: Director of Data Center and Mainframe Operations

threat_event: Hurricane makes DC-1 unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC-1 in Florida
existing_controls: DC-2 out of region; annual failover
treatment_plan: Pre-season failover drill each June

threat_event: Configuration drift or an unsupported operating system on core middleware servers is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 48 servers drifted; 4 on an OS in extended support
treatment_plan: Remediate drift; upgrade 4 servers (POAM-008)

threat_event: Missed patch targets on payments hub and core middleware servers are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 60 sampled findings exceeded 30 days
treatment_plan: Monthly payments patch window; exception tracking (POAM-009)

threat_event: Contact center social engineering changes a customer's phone or email, enabling takeover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Knowledge-based caller authentication for some requests
existing_controls: Caller authentication; alerts to old contact details
treatment_plan: Require in-app approval or one-time code to the old contact for contact changes
owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking

threat_event: Remote-access scams on trusted customer devices add payees without step-up
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Step-up skipped on trusted devices
treatment_plan: Step-up for all new payees (POAM-005)

threat_event: Commercial client service staff act on spoofed instructions for lack of BEC training
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No role-based BEC training for client service staff
treatment_plan: Role-based BEC training (POAM-015)

threat_event: A deepfake voice passes a callback or impersonates an executive to approve a payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Callbacks rely on voice recognition of known contacts
existing_controls: Callback to number on file; dual approval
treatment_plan: Add a shared secret or in-app confirmation for high-value callbacks

threat_event: Authorized push payment scams drain customer funds through irrevocable instant payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Instant payments are irrevocable
existing_controls: Fraud scoring; payee name check; limits
treatment_plan: Scam warnings and cooling-off for first payments to new payees

threat_event: ACH files from a commercial client are altered in transit or at the client
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Host-to-host channels
existing_controls: File encryption and signing; control totals
treatment_plan: Extend file signing to all host-to-host clients

threat_event: Card-not-present fraud and card enumeration attacks on debit cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large card portfolio
existing_controls: Processor fraud models; network liability rules
treatment_plan: Rely on network chargeback rules and processor fraud tools; monitor losses
owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking

threat_event: ATM skimming or jackpotting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,480 ATMs
treatment_plan: Accept: residual Low with vendor controls
owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking

threat_event: Broker-dealer customers are notified late because service providers are not bound to give notice within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 of 31 broker-dealer service provider contracts, including the clearing firm, lack the Regulation S-P 72-hour term
treatment_plan: Amend 14 contracts (POAM-021)

threat_event: The broker-dealer misses the Regulation S-P 30-day customer notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broker-dealer response procedures updated 2025-11
treatment_plan: Joint exercise with the bank incident team

threat_event: Customer notices in a multi-state incident are late or inconsistent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Six footprint states plus customers who moved elsewhere
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.g); N52-R02 (Supp. A III); state breach laws
treatment_plan: Annual refresh of the state matrix

threat_event: A SAR is filed late because a security incident is not linked to a BSA case
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Case management links security and fraud cases
treatment_plan: Accept: controls operating

threat_event: The Item 106 disclosure describes processes that do not operate as described
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Independence and third-party gaps must be described accurately
treatment_plan: Internal Audit tests the Item 106 statements each year

threat_event: Cyber key risk indicators are compiled by hand, so board risk reports may be inaccurate or late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: App. D II.J expects risk data aggregation and reporting capabilities
treatment_plan: Automate cyber KRIs in the risk data platform (POAM-016)
owner: Director of Technology and Operational Risk

threat_event: The annual independent assessment of the risk governance framework does not cover technology and cyber risk in depth
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 assessment sampled credit and liquidity only
treatment_plan: Include technology and cyber risk in the 2026 assessment (POAM-024)

threat_event: Customer information is exposed on a lost or stolen laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption on all laptops
treatment_plan: Accept: encryption makes impact unlikely

threat_event: Customer data is misdirected (email to the wrong recipient or statement to an old address)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High volume of communications
existing_controls: Address verification; email data loss prevention
treatment_plan: Accept: low impact per event; tracked

threat_event: Over-privileged analysts access raw customer data on the enterprise data platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad analyst roles
treatment_plan: Quarterly certification of data set access; masking by default

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes a data store publicly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails block public storage
treatment_plan: Keep guardrails; quarterly guardrail tests

threat_event: A cloud administrator credential is stolen and the control plane is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phishing-resistant MFA and just-in-time elevation
treatment_plan: Continue; annual red team of the control plane

threat_event: An API flaw lets one customer see another customer's accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complex entitlement model for business users
treatment_plan: Automated authorization tests for every API release

threat_event: The legacy commercial platform cannot be restored within the 8-hour BIA RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract RTO 24 h; restore never tested
treatment_plan: Migration by 2027-02-26 (POAM-004)

threat_event: Acquired bank customer data remains in decommissioned systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy data stores awaiting certified deletion
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B II.B.4); N52-R02 (App. B III.C.4)
treatment_plan: Certified deletion after the retention review

threat_event: Loss of mainframe skills slows recovery and change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Aging mainframe workforce
treatment_plan: Apprenticeship program and vendor managed-services option
key_risk_indicator: Critical roles with a trained backup

threat_event: The core software release reaches end of vendor support in 2028
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Upgrade planned 2027
treatment_plan: Accept until the 2027 upgrade

threat_event: AI-001 performance drifts after economic change and losses rise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recent deployment; limited downturn data
regulatory_driver: SR 26-2 (outcomes analysis); ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.2(p))
treatment_plan: Challenger model and stress scenarios by Model Risk Management
key_risk_indicator: Population stability; loss rate versus forecast

threat_event: Vendor AI features are switched on inside SaaS tools without intake review and process customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Several SaaS vendors are adding AI features
treatment_plan: Contract clause requiring notice of AI features; intake gate in change management

threat_event: The contact center agent assistant (AI-009) gives agents wrong account guidance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generative summaries; agents verify
treatment_plan: Monthly accuracy sampling
owner: Head of Consumer and Small Business Banking

threat_event: The customer virtual assistant (AI-008) gives misleading answers about fees or disputes, or is manipulated by prompt injection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generative assistant with retrieval from public content
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (App. B III.C.1.d); consumer protection laws
existing_controls: Answer grounding; blocked account actions; human handoff
treatment_plan: Red-team testing before each release; complaint monitoring

threat_event: The AML alert prioritization model (AI-005) suppresses alerts that should be investigated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model validated 2025
treatment_plan: Annual below-threshold testing

threat_event: Physical intrusion at a data center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Layered physical security
treatment_plan: Accept: residual Low
owner: Director of Data Center and Mainframe Operations

threat_event: Loss of wire operations staff (illness or site loss) in Florida
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alternate room in Georgia
treatment_plan: Accept: alternate room tested

threat_event: An AI resume screening feature (AI-014) produces adverse impact if enabled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature available in the HR system but not enabled
treatment_plan: Avoid: keep disabled unless the AI governance committee approves after an adverse impact analysis

threat_event: Staff paste customer information into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public tools blocked at the web proxy
treatment_plan: Avoid: public generative AI domains stay blocked; approved assistant only
